tldr: The target is a uniform all-sequence expected welfare-regret equivalent and joint critical experiment for sign deployment of the published honest IPW variance-maximizing stump. The primitive error class maintains common unknown variance and a fixed standardized exponential envelope; these restrictions are stronger than CKY\textquotesingle s arm-specific positive second moments and law-specific local exponential moments. A fixed-law variant permits unequal arm variances and law-dependent tail constants. The Gaussian subclass retains exact finite-sample calibration. Rare endpoint loss, conditional interior localization moments, honest sign mistakes, and empty leaves remain in the target. The regime separation is strict against the full-data public-midpoint sign rule and, for positive slopes, Crippa\textquotesingle s final equation (3) threshold EWM. Quantitative smooth-drift competition and moment transfer are open. The theorem package supplies a specified-estimator welfare-risk bound; its historical priority over inaccessible older CUSUM texts is not asserted.
